_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/rokin_noord.json — RoomSpec for Rokin (the city, district 3: Rokin): the north half of Rokin: the head of the basin and Queen Wilhelmina on her horse, the metro's way in (shut: the station has flooded), the police post, an aid post in the road with an ambulance and a police van left by it, and across the end of the street, at the Dam, an army checkpoint, abandoned. Modelled after openly licensed photographs; every business name is made up, the landmarks keep theirs. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor (street.py, city.py and landmarks.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).

interactables.text: Queen Wilhelmina on her horse, looking north up Rokin. Someone has tied a child's balloon to her stirrup.
An army checkpoint across the end of Rokin, abandoned: the barriers still up, one shoved aside. The Dam is beyond, all lit up.
A first aid post. They were checking everyone here before the trams. Under the sheet is someone they couldn't help.
